meaning: Global Network Kapital - Advanced Sports & Governance
positioning: Corporate intelligence, strategic capital, advanced sport, technology and governance.

typography.note: Do not bundle font files; use system fallback or approved webfont loading later.

news_migration.rule: News should be structurally separated from the main homepage to keep the corporate front fast.

design_rules: Preserve portal functions; redesign information architecture and UI hierarchy.
Use snapshot-first data rendering and lazy-load heavy visual modules.
Use smaller standardized cards; remove oversized blocks from homepage.
Keep documents, PDFs and legal/financial material available through structured download hubs.
Use the new brand palette and logo system consistently across pages.
